courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 升降式水閘門吊裝
related.transfer: 可遷移「曲面水壓與水平力」與「支臂長細與屈曲」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；升降式水閘門吊裝的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Curved pressure and horizontal force" and "Arm slenderness and buckling" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Vertical-lift water-gate erection must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以鉸軸幾何受力傳遞與同步試運轉安裝弧門；升降式水閘門吊裝則以以導軌輪壓啟閉力及幾何查核組立升降門為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on installing radial gates through trunnion geometry load paths and synchronized commissioning; Vertical-lift water-gate erection centres on erecting lift gates through guide geometry wheel reactions and operating-force checks, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「曲面水壓與水平力」與「矩形門葉靜水力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到升降式水閘門吊裝，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「鋼索彈性與行程」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Curved pressure and horizontal force” and “Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Vertical-lift water-gate erection, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Rope elasticity and travel", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 大壩止水帶施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「曲面水壓與水平力」與「支臂長細與屈曲」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；大壩止水帶施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.difference: 本課聚焦以鉸軸幾何受力傳遞與同步試運轉安裝弧門；大壩止水帶施工則以以接縫變形材料接續與澆置品質形成連續止水為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on installing radial gates through trunnion geometry load paths and synchronized commissioning; Dam waterstop installation centres on forming continuous water barriers through joint movement splicing and placement quality, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「曲面水壓與水平力」與「水壓高度與接縫」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到大壩止水帶施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「狹縫層流與敏感度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Curved pressure and horizontal force” and “Head pressure and joints”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Dam waterstop installation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Slot flow and sensitivity", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大型弧形閘門安裝
history.text: 本課所研究的以鉸軸幾何受力傳遞與同步試運轉安裝弧門，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。算例為準靜態簡化構件，起吊與蓄水驗收仍須核准吊裝計畫、結構分析及現場量測。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。
history.textEn: The focus on installing radial gates through trunnion geometry load paths and synchronized commissioning reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Examples idealize quasi-static components; lifting and impoundment acceptance require approved plans structural analysis and field measurements. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.
